description.value: The Fernie Taphouse is a historic gastropub at the heart of downtown Fernie, housed in a building rebuilt after the Great Fire of 1908 with bootlegger tunnels still intact beneath it. It offers a wide menu of classic pub fare — from beer-battered fish and chips to rotating daily specials — alongside 20+ rotating BC craft beers on tap and a heated seasonal patio. The venue is actively community-connected, sponsoring local cycling events such as the Gravel Grind Post Race Afterparty and the Fernie Trails & Touring Club.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms The Fernie Taphouse is an active, open gastropub at 691 1st Ave, Fernie — address matches OSM. Takeout is confirmed by 'Give us a shout for take-out!' and 'Easy Online ordering is available – for pick up or local delivery.' Wi-Fi is mentioned specifically for the private meeting room ('WiFi and TV access'). No phone number appears on the website or in OSM tags. No explicit mention of bike parking, water refill, or washrooms on the website, so those remain null per evidence rules. The About page confirms community sponsorships including the Gravel Grind Post Race Afterparty and Fernie Trails & Touring Club, noting cyclist-community connections.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM tags or on the business website; contact page relies solely on a web form.
Wi-Fi confirmed only for the private meeting room — general patron Wi-Fi availability is unconfirmed.
